invariant_review_justification: This release adds a static pre-auth marketing page and one client-side routing change. It introduces no new aggregate, mirrored configuration, generated artifact, or denormalized summary; it reads only the pre-existing /api/public/config endpoint that was already exposed to unauthenticated callers and already covered by PROD-6 (tests/api.test.mjs).
